_comment: Copy this file to mads.config.json and edit the path for your own machine. Do NOT commit mads.config.json — it contains a machine-specific path and is already in .gitignore.
_claudeBin_why: On some Windows installs, Mads-Lens's automatic claude.exe detection (server/claudeProcess.ts) fails with 'spawn claude ENOENT' even though `claude --version` works fine in PowerShell. This happens when the @anthropic-ai/claude-code npm package ships the binary as bin\claude.exe instead of the older cli.js layout the detection logic expects. If you hit this, find the real path with `Get-Content (where.exe claude.cmd)` (it prints the exe path it calls), then set claudeBin below to that exact path.
